coat_thickness_from_image — DRIVE polish op

• Data kinds: image2d × scalar → image2d

• Call: import fullseye as fs; fs.ledger.coat_thickness_from_image(image, coat: 'float', optical_depth: 'float' = 1.3862943611198906, bare: 'float' = 0.85) -> 'np.ndarray' (to call the implementation directly, import polish; polish.coat_thickness_from_image(image, coat: 'float', optical_depth: 'float' = 1.3862943611198906, bare: 'float' = 0.85) -> 'np.ndarray'; from the registry, opsdrive.get("coat_thickness_from_image"))

Usage

Inverse of coat_image: t = h0 ln(bare/I)/τ, clipped to [0, h0]. Raises ValueError: image checks, numeric checks.
